Definition: properly, a circlet, i.e. a diadem
BiblicalUsage: Kether means a crown, a diadem, a circlet. Esther 1:11 says bring Vashti the queen before the king with the crown royal, to shew the people her beauty. Esther 2:17 says the king set the royal crown upon Esther's head, and made her queen instead of Vashti. Esther 6:8 says let the royal apparel be brought, and the crown royal which is set upon his head.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the crown passes in this book from the disobedient to the chosen: Vashti wore it and refused, Esther wore it and risked her life. I hold that a crown is only safe on the head God puts it on.
